items.name: 01-hero-angled-shaker-doors
items.prompt: A British terraced house hallway seen from the front door end. A straight flight of stairs rises along the right-hand wall, and the space under it is closed in with a painted timber cupboard front that fills the triangle under the stairs exactly. The front has three made-to-measure shaker doors painted soft sage green with small round brass knobs: the tallest door at the high end, a medium door in the middle and a short door at the low end, and the top edge of every door is cut on an angle that runs parallel to the slope of the stair string above it, with an even narrow gap. Butt hinges on the vertical edge of each door. White oak treads with white spindles above, cream walls, wooden floorboards, a jute runner.
